strategy.summary: Collect A and P to light the blue bumpers for 100. Then shoot through the upper gaps beside the R and Y lanes. Use gentle nudges to protect every side-lane feed.

quickInfo.name: A-P letters
quickInfo.summary: Collect A and P from the top lanes or matching standups, and keep collected letters between balls.

quickInfo.name: Blue bumpers
quickInfo.summary: Collecting both A and P lights the blue bumpers for 100 points per hit.

quickInfo.name: Upper route
quickInfo.summary: The main scoring route passes between a bumper and the adjacent upper R or Y lane.

quickInfo.name: R-Y feeds
quickInfo.summary: Balls from the R and Y side lanes usually reach the opposite flipper, but slope can change the feed.

quickInfo.name: F-C feeds
quickInfo.summary: Balls from the lower F and C side lanes can travel directly toward the outlanes or center drain.

steps.text: Plunge for A or P. Record which of the two letters is still missing.
If a letter is missing, shoot only its matching mid-playfield standup from a controlled ball.
After A and P are complete, shoot through the gap between a blue bumper and the upper lane.
Aim slightly toward the outer lane face. Avoid the inside bumper edge and nearby posts.
Guide each R or Y side-lane feed toward the opposite flipper. Use a gentle nudge before the lower letter lanes.
Control the ball, then repeat the upper route while its feed remains predictable.

fallback.title: Missing-letter recovery
fallback.when: Use this plan when the plunge does not collect both A and P.

steps.text: Identify the missing A or P letter.
Trap the ball before you shoot the matching side standup.
Make one controlled standup shot. Prepare for a fast rebound.
After both letters are complete, stop shooting standups and return to the upper route.

alternatives.title: R-Y side-lane loop
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the R and Y feeds reach the opposite flipper cleanly on this machine.

steps.text: Shoot toward the outer face of the R or Y lane.
Guide the side-lane feed away from the lower letter-lane divider.
Catch the ball on the opposite flipper.
Use the controlled ball for another upper shot.
Collect A and P to light the blue bumpers for 100.
Send controlled shots into the upper bumper area.
Use safe R and Y returns to change flippers.
Repeat the upper route without returning to the dangerous standups.

techniques.name: Outside miss
techniques.instruction: Aim toward the outer face of an R or Y lane. An outside miss is safer than a hit on the adjacent bumper edge.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Watch the full R or Y side-lane feed. Use a small nudge above the lower letter lanes to guide the ball to the opposite flipper.

cautions.issue: The A and P standups can produce dangerous rebounds.
cautions.response: Use them only for a missing letter. Stop shooting them after both letters are complete.

cautions.issue: An F or C side-lane feed can drain through an outlane or the center.
cautions.response: Nudge before the ball reaches the lower divider. Guide the ball back toward a flipper.

cautions.issue: Posts beside the targets and bumpers create fast, unpredictable rebounds.
cautions.response: Use the open upper gaps. Stop direct target shots after A and P are complete.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Gottlieb Flying Carpet and tournament treatment of replay awards.
Test A and P targets, upper gaps, R-Y exits, and F-C side lanes.
strategy.simpleOverview: Flying Carpet carries A and P between balls and lights its blue bumpers for 100 after both letters are collected. Finish A-P, send the ball through the upper gaps beside R and Y, and use gentle nudges to preserve the safer cross-playfield returns.
strategy.overview: Flying Carpet carries A and P between balls and lights its blue bumpers for 100 after both letters are collected. Collect A and P, then repeat controlled feeds into the upper area while learning each side-lane return. Favor R-Y crossovers and avoid deliberate F-C or standup shots when their feeds move toward an outlane or the center.
machineSetup: Confirm Gottlieb Flying Carpet and tournament treatment of replay awards.
